item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows four objects Uma labels W, X, Y and Z: a glowing lamp, a wooden block, a lit candle flame, and a mirror.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: W and Y are luminous because they emit their own light; X and Z are non-luminous.
options.B: Z is luminous because a mirror looks bright in a lit room.
options.C: X is luminous because wood can burn later.
options.D: Only W is luminous; a candle flame does not emit its own light.
